title: 香蕉棒球创始人Jesse Cole：从两张票到500万人等候名单，棒球还能这样玩？
speaker: Jesse Cole

segments.en: Well, I played baseball my whole life and you know I realized that there were some parts of the game there may be too long too slow too boring
segments.zh: 我打了一辈子棒球，我意识到比赛的某些部分可能太长、太慢、太无聊。

segments.en: And we wanted to change it and then in our company's fans first entertainment. So you know, we thought what would fans want and so why can't fans catch a foul ball and have it be an out during a game
segments.zh: 我们想改变它。我们公司的理念是粉丝优先的娱乐。所以我们想，粉丝想要什么？为什么粉丝不能接住界外球，直接算作出局？

segments.en: Why not you know, why can't we have big celebrations and dancing players and dancing umpires? You know, why can't we just make the game faster and more exciting? And so
segments.zh: 为什么不呢？为什么不能有盛大的庆祝、跳舞的球员和跳舞的裁判？为什么不能让比赛更快、更刺激？

segments.en: We've built this one step at a time. You know, we started my wife and I we only sold two tickets when we started. We were sleeping on an air bed and now to see that there's five million people on a wait list
segments.zh: 我们一步一步建起来。我和妻子刚开始只卖了两张票，睡在充气床上，现在等候名单上有五百万人。

segments.en: We've been selling out a hundred thousand seats stadiums and it's just amazing now our biggest game our Super Bowl is here with all six teams. And it's been an amazing journey over the last 11 years Jesse and David you can find me on that wait list
segments.zh: 我们卖光了十万座的体育场，太不可思议了。现在我们最大的比赛，我们的超级碗，六支球队都来了。过去11年是一段奇妙的旅程。Jesse和David，你们可以在等候名单上找到我。
